newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Kelani Valley up on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Kelani Valley up on retail buying.

text.p: Retail buying boosted the shares of Kelani Valley Plantations Ltd by 2.3 percent or 50 cents to 22 rupees on Thursday, brokers said.
"Small retail investors are attracted to plantation shares because they are cheap, fairly liquid and offer good growth prospects," said a broker who declined to be named.
Tea shares have been on a roll as prices of the commodity have reached record levels in 1996, he said.
Kelani Valley is one of six plantation firms privatised in late 1995.
